channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Alabama Semiquincentennial Commission to offer community grants beginning Jan. 30
item.description: The Alabama USA Semiquincentennial Commission announced plans to distribute up to $725,000 in grant funding to support local commemorations of the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence.

item.title: Max Motorsports fuels Pelham’s powersports passion with family-owned approach
item.description: For more than two decades, Max Motorsports has been helping riders across Central Alabama stay on the road—and in the dirt—by combining technical expertise with a passion for the sport that runs deep within its walls.

item.title: Veteran Pelham baseball squad looks to take next step in second year under Guy Howard
item.description: Pelham baseball enters the 2026 season with momentum, experience and a clear vision of what success looks like.

item.title: Oak Mountain, Briarwood enter boys basketball rankings as Pelham rises, Chelsea girls hold
item.description: Oak Mountain and Briarwood joined the ASWA’s boys basketball rankings alongside Pelham at No. 4 for Class 6A boys and Chelsea at No. 9 for Class 6A girls.

item.title: Miss Hoover's Teen, city of Hoover hosting competitive fundraiser for American Heart Association
item.description: The Hoover Police Department and Hoover Fire Department are competing to to raise the most money for the American Heart Association.

item.title: Christian Brothers Automotive opens in Helena
item.description: Residents of Helena and the surrounding areas now have another option for auto-related services, as a Christian Brothers Automotive location has opened its doors to the community.

item.title: Suspect identified in Calera police evasion arrest
item.description: The Calera Police Department has identified Darrell Lemuel Cotton as the suspect arrested in a police evasion situation.

item.title: Crafting champions: ACS celebrates completion of workforce development academy
item.description: Alabaster City Schools held a ribbon cutting for the ACS Champions Craft Academy on Wednesday, Jan. 28

item.title: Pelham clinches No. 2 seed in area tournament after sweeping Spain Park
item.description: Pelham swept the season series with Spain Park and clinched the No. 2 seed in the area after rallying from a one-point halftime deficit to win by double digits.

item.title: Calera provides update on Waterford shooting investigation
item.description: The Calera Police Department provided an update on the investigation into a shooting that took place in the Waterford subdivision on Jan. 20, and identified Chyanne Kaliyah Robinson as the suspect arrested in connection with the incident.
